title: Teri Bimar Behen
body:
Jake Pardes Me Akbar Se Koi Keh Deta
Teri Bimar Behen Dar Pe Khadi Rehti Hai
Rasta Takti Hai Bas Sham O Seher Woh Tera
Teri bimar...
Tumne Wada Tha Kiya Lene Tujhe Aunga
Tere Wade Ke Saharey Hun Abhi Tak Zinda-2
Kya hua Bhai Mere Ku Nahi Lene Aya
Teri Bimar behen Dar Pe Khadi rehti hai
Uskey wade Ko Usey Yaad Dilade Koi
Kitni bimar Hun Main Jake Bata de Koi-2
Jake Pardes Me Ku Bhai Mera Bhul Gaya
Teri Bimar behen.
Har Ghadi Teri Judai Ka He Gham Hai Bhaiyya
Haye Ummid Mere Jine Ki Kam Hai Bhiayya-2
Sans Lena Bhi yaha hogaya dushwar mera
Teri bimar behen
Meri hasrat Thi Tere Sar Pe Sajaun sehra
Mere Dil Me He Na Reh Jaye Ye Arman Mera-2
Main Na Mar Jaun Tere Aney Se Pehle Bhaiyya
Teri bimar ....
Baba Gar Baad Mere shadi rachaye Teri
Kabr Par Sath Me Tu Bhabhi Ko Lana Meri
Ilteja Tumse Ye Karti Hai Tumhari Behna...
Teri Bimar Behen
Main Akeyli Hoon Yaha Paas Mere Koi nhi
Meri Tanhai Ka Ehsas Kisi Ko Bhi Nahi
Dam Nikal Jayega Tanhai Me Mere Baba
Teri bimar behen...
Jab Bhi Yasrab Me Nazar Ate Hai Chote Bacche.
Yaad Atee Hai Mujhe Aun O Muhammad mere
Meri Akhon Me Utar Ata hai chehra unka..
Teri bimar.....
Padhke Khat Beti Ka Ye Kehte The rokar sarwar
Koi Sughra Se Ye Keh deta Madine Ja kar
Laut kar ab na watan ayega bhai tere
Teri bimar....
Raasta Takti Ho Jis Bhai Ka Sughra Aksar
Mar gaya bhai kaleje pe sina woh khakar
Koi sughra Ko ye tufail Bata De Itna
Teri bimar behen....
